PARAMS = {
    "Wn": (12.0, 4.0, 40.0),     # NMOS driver width [um]
    "Ln": (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),       # NMOS driver length [um]
    "Lp": (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),       # PMOS driver length [um]
    "R1": (4e3, 2e3, 12e3),      # input resistor [ohm]
    "R2": (60e3, 30e3, 180e3),   # feedback resistor [ohm]
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = spec["vin_dc"]; cl = spec["cl"]; vdd = 1.8
    Wn, Ln, Lp, R1, R2 = p["Wn"], p["Ln"], p["Lp"], p["R1"], p["R2"]

    # DC point: the feedback forces vgate ~ vout ~ vin (trip point = vin_dc)
    vg = vin; vo = vin
    opn = lut.op('n', Wn, Ln, vg, vo)
    Id = opn["Id"]
    # Solve the PMOS width so that Ip = In at Vsg = vdd - vin, Vsd = vdd - vout
    opp1 = lut.op('p', 1.0, Lp, vdd - vg, vdd - vo)
    Wp = min(max(Id / max(opp1["Id"], 1e-12), 0.42), 4000.0)
    opp = lut.op('p', Wp, Lp, vdd - vg, vdd - vo)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.R("R1", "vin", "g", R1)
    n.R("R2", "g", "vout", R2)
    n.M("MN", "vout", "g", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.M("MP", "vout", "g", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    # Reference current sink (IREF is not needed for biasing)
    n.M("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 1.0)

    # Small-signal predictions
    gm = opn["gm"] + opp["gm"]
    gds = opn["gds"] + opp["gds"]
    Gout = gds + 1.0 / (R1 + R2)
    A0 = gm / Gout
    beta = R1 / (R1 + R2)
    T = A0 * beta
    acl = (R2 / R1) * T / (1 + T)
    cpar = 1.0e-15 * (Wn + Wp) * 0.8          # rough estimate of drain-junction + overlap cap
    cout = cl + cpar
    gbw = (R2 / (R1 + R2)) * gm / (2 * PI * cout)
    cgd = 0.3e-15 * (Wn + Wp)
    f_fb = 1.0 / (2 * PI * R2 * cgd)           # R2 || Cgd feedback pole
    f3 = gbw / acl
    f3 = 1.0 / math.sqrt(1.0 / f3**2 + 1.0 / f_fb**2)
    iref_guess = 10e-6
    power = vdd * (Id + iref_guess)
    return n, {
        "gain_db": 20 * math.log10(max(acl, 1e-9)),
        "f3db": f3,
        "gbw": acl * f3,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vo,
        "swing": 1.55,
    }
